name: QRX
tagline: Art QR codes that always scan, made from a prompt and a link
description: QRX turns a text prompt and a link into a branded, print-ready QR code. Each code is checked to decode before it is returned and points at a hosted qrx.to short link. Cline can start a code, wait for the image, list your codes, re-point a code's link, check your daily allowance and list the available styles. Generation is asynchronous and usually takes under a minute. Free accounts get 42 codes a day.
